import math
# Compare candidate predicates from absolute or cross-relative coords on demo 10
samples=[(r,c, out10[r][c]==4) for r in range(10) for c in range(10) if r!=4 and c!=6]
# Check simple predicates using offsets and x/y or distances
for coord in ['abs','dist','quad']:
 for a in range(-2,4):
  for b in range(-2,4):
   for op in ['andzero','andnonzero','andparity','xorparity','sum_even','prod_even','gcd_gt1','less','eq']:
    def pred(r,c):
     if coord=='abs': x,y=r+a,c+b
     elif coord=='dist': x=abs(4-r)+a; y=abs(6-c)+b
     else: x=(4-r if r<4 else r-4)+a; y=(6-c if c<6 else c-6)+b
     if op=='andzero': return (x&y)==0
     if op=='andnonzero': return (x&y)!=0
     if op=='andparity': return ((x&y).bit_count()%2)==1
     if op=='xorparity': return ((x^y).bit_count()%2)==1
     if op=='sum_even': return (x+y)%2==0
     if op=='prod_even': return (x*y)%2==0
     if op=='gcd_gt1': return math.gcd(x,y)>1
     if op=='less': return x<y
     return x==y
    score=sum(pred(r,c)==v for r,c,v in samples)
    if score>=len(samples)*.9: print(coord,a,b,op,score,len(samples))

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    hr = next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 3 for v in row))
    vc = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h)))
    out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        row=[]
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 3:
                row.append(3)
            else:
                y,x=abs(r-hr),abs(c-vc)
                row.append(4 if ((y%2==0 and x<=y) or (x%2==0 and x>y)) else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
# Demo input grids inferred from all-blank grid crossed at the stated axes.
in10=[[3 if r==4 or c==6 else 0 for c in range(10)] for r in range(10)]
in20=[[3 if r==5 or c==7 else 0 for c in range(20)] for r in range(20)]
print('demo10 match:',transform(in10)==out10)
print('demo20 match:',transform(in20)==out20)
# Construct target from prompt and run the program transform.
test=[[3 if r==8 or c==6 else 0 for c in range(12)] for r in range(12)]
test_out=transform(test)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in test_out))
